summary: US initial jobless claims 200,000 in the week to 7 Nov; 4-week average 195,250, at its 52-week low
state: Initial US jobless claims were 200,000 in the week to 7 Nov, with the four-week average at 195,250, its 52-week low and far below the 15% Watch line (FRED). Layoffs remain low by historical standards. Figures for the week to 14 Nov are due on 19 Nov.
